features.feature: Read-only incremental-context helper: for (storyId, reviewer role) returns prior verdict + bound headHash + diff since last-pass headHash + scopeChanged boolean
First-pass fallback: no prior pass -> full diff main...HEAD, isFirstPass=true, scopeChanged=true
Rename-aware diff: uses --name-status -M via changedFilesBetween (reuses evidence-freshness helper)
Helper is strictly read-only: no writes, no gate or store side effects
lattice review_incremental_context CLI: --storyId + --role flags, English-only output (prior verdict, scopeChanged, incremental diff)
Round>=2 REVIEW-entry advisory: lists which active reviewers scope changed + states round-2+ gate needs >=1 valid receipt + operator MAY re-run only scope-changed reviewers
Round 1 REVIEW entry shows NO targeted re-review advisory (only round>=2)
Advisory is append-only inside try/catch: never throws, never alters transition result, worded as operator choice (framework skips nobody)
canPassReviewGuard semantics UNCHANGED: gate behavior identical with and without the helper
Smoke/tests: returning reviewer gets since-last-pass incremental context; first-timer gets full diff; rename case counts as changed

Smoke asserts gate-unchanged: Round 1 blocks unless all opt-in have valid current-round verdicts + quorum; Round 2+ passes on >=1 valid receipt; invalid binding blocks all rounds; blocking finding blocks

CLAUDE.md REVIEW section updated with accurate gate behavior (invalid-binding blocks all rounds; Round 1 all opt-in + quorum; Round 2+ >=1 receipt + no blocking) plus the incremental-context CLI and round-2+ targeted re-review guidance
All artifacts and emitted strings are English-only
story-lifecycle.md Round 2+ gate rule (>=1 valid current-round receipt; stale prior-round verdicts excluded) is surfaced as advisory, not changed
story-lifecycle.md gate rule: REVIEW evidence bound to reviewer run via review_run_start (headHash/materialHash); finding_add/review_pass_set must carry reviewRunId
features.excluded_by: Scope boundary: this story only reads reviewer run headHash for incremental diff computation; it does not modify review_run_start, finding_add, review_pass_set, or the review run binding protocol

features.feature: three-round-two-host escalation: first REVIEW round >=2 countable problems triggers 3x2 requirement
features.excluded_by: Scope boundary explicitly excludes any gate/binding change; the 3x2 escalation path and its DONE gate are unrelated to this story which only adds an informational CLI and advisory
